title: Bid Document Checklist Item
description: The template of required bid documents for one Procurement Activity, grouped by section (Administrative/Technical/Legal/Financial). Matches public.rfq_document_checklist. No ownerId column -- writes are gated by owns_procurement_activity(activityId) at the DB level instead of row ownership. Per-bidder Pass/Fail against these items lives in rfq-checklist-result.schema.json.
